sources.finding: Published 13 May 2026; current fixed availability snapshot January 2026; fixed line and FWA; official fixed ZIP listed as 32.2 MB.

V2 07/07/2026. Coverage submissions are for premises where an end-user could order service; take-up is active full-fibre lines. AddressBase Premium/Islands Epoch 123 premise base. All-premises postcode coverage is 121 r2 files / 1,741,096 rows; residential postcode set remains 121 r1 files / 1,606,191 rows.

Design stage 5 In build explicitly means service is not yet available to take up. Stage 6 RFS means build/testing complete and service can be ordered/provisioned within industry-standard timescales. RFI premise list also cites AddressBase Premium Epoch 123.
Latest published premises-level OMR collection remains January 2026 as of 24 July 2026.
Updated 7 July 2026; checker uses January OMR published June 2026; next update September; complete status accuracy not guaranteed.
May OMR closed 1 June; responses are evaluated before postcode/UPRN outputs are published; next OMR September.
ONSPD and NSPL use distinct higher-geography methodologies; postcode products released quarterly Feb/May/Aug/Nov.
Postcodes may straddle administrative boundaries, change continuously and can be reused elsewhere after two years.

guards: OFcom availability means orderable fixed service, not active-line take-up
BDUK In build is future/non-orderable; only RFS qualifies as orderable under the OMR definition
AddressBase Epoch 123 alignment is provenance context, not automatic row identity
May OMR closure is not published May OMR output
Address Checker current/planned label is advisory and not guaranteed completely accurate
ONS geography/lifecycle cannot create broadband availability
no current-r2 product row without runtime archive and provenance
